release_notes:
[WINDOWS-ONLY TEST — TEMPORARY]
Manifest ini hanya menyediakan Windows x64. macOS clients tidak mendapat paket sampai manifest multi-platform lengkap diterbitkan.

AutoCleanFeatureX V6.67.1 by Elmo
Windows x64 — Temporary Validation Release

Changes:
- Moved Delete Create controls into a dedicated group below USING.
- Updated Windows package downloads to use system curl.exe with Schannel TLS certificate verification.
- Improved Windows portable updater staging, rollback handling, configuration preservation, and application relaunch.

Windows validation:
- Verified signed manifest and package integrity.
- Verified Windows x64 ZIP and update helper.
- Tested local installation from simulated V6.67.0 to V6.67.1.
- Verified automatic application relaunch and preservation of network settings.

Important:
- This is a temporary Windows-only validation release.
- macOS Intel and Apple Silicon packages are not included.
- Do not promote this release as the final cross-platform release until complete macOS packages are available.
